name: How long does it take to complete a pantry addition?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a pantry addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: A pantry addition timeline varies from a couple of weeks to several months depending on structural complexity. Converting an existing closet or installing modular custom pantry cabinetry typically takes two to three weeks of on-site construction once materials arrive. A custom framed walk-in pantry involving wall reconfiguration, lighting updates, and finish trim generally requires three to five weeks. If your pantry involves a structural exterior bump-out addition with foundation work and exterior siding, the schedule extends longer to account for framing inspections and weather-dependent exterior tasks.
acceptedAnswer.description: A cabinet conversion takes about two to three weeks, while a framed walk-in or structural bump-out pantry can take four weeks or more depending on project scope.
